steps.title: Prepare TCR and CD8 Plasmids
steps.instruction: Order, clone, and midi-prep the following plasmids, ensuring high quality for further use:

substeps.instruction: pcDNA3.1( )-OTI-TCRA (addgene Catalog #131035)
pcDNA3.1( )-OTI-TCRB (addgene Catalog #131036)
Cd8a (NM_001081110) Mouse Tagged ORF Clone (OriGene Catalog #MR227539)
Cd8b1 (NM_009858) Mouse Tagged ORF Clone (OriGene Catalog #MR225204)

steps.title: Linearize Plasmids
steps.instruction: Linearize plasmids using enzymes at the end of their inserts. Use EcoRI-HF (10,000 units, NEB #R3101S) for OT-I plasmids and NotI-HF (2,500 units, NEB #R3189L) for mouse CD8s.

substeps.instruction: Combine 50 µg of plasmid DNA, 25 µL of the corresponding restriction enzyme, and 25 µL of 10X CutSmart Buffer.
Top the reaction with nuclease-free water to a final volume of 250 µL.
Incubate at 37 °C for at least 1 hour.
Verify linearization via agarose gel electrophoresis if necessary.

steps.title: Extract Linearized DNA
steps.instruction: Perform a standard phenol:chloroform extraction to recover the linearized DNA:

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL of nuclease-free water to the restriction reaction (final volume 500 µL).
Add 500 µL of phenol:chloroform, vortex well, and spin at 14,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer the aqueous layer to a new tube, add 500 µL chloroform, vortex well, and spin at 14,000 rpm for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Transfer the aqueous layer to a new tube, add 1000 µL absolute EtOH, mix by inverting, and keep at -20 °C for at least 30 minutes.
Spin at 14,000 rpm for 30 minutes at 4 °C; discard supernatant.
Wash the pellet with 500 µL 70% EtOH and spin at 14,000 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Discard supernatant, remove residual alcohol, and resuspend the pellet in 50 µL nuclease-free water.
Estimate DNA concentration using a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Culture Jurkat-NFAT Cells
steps.instruction: Thaw and culture Jurkat-NFAT cells (Promega #J1621) using the specified media.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Jurkat media: 500 mL Corning™ RPMI 1640 Medium (Mod.) 1X with L-Glutamine, 50 mL Fetal Plus®, and 5 mL Penicillin-Streptromycin (10,000 U/mL).
Seed 5 million cells in 50 mL of Jurkat media in a T75 flask.
Culture for at least 3 days or until density reaches 1.5 million cells/mL.

steps.title: Culture MC38 Cells
steps.instruction: Thaw and culture MC38 cells as effectors.

substeps.instruction: Seed approximately 2 million cells in a T75 flask.
Culture for at least 3 days to obtain sufficient cells for co-culture.

steps.title: Prepare Recovery Plate
steps.instruction: Fill 4 wells of a 6-well culture plate with 6 mL of warm Jurkat media to serve as a recovery plate after electroporation.

steps.title: Prepare Jurkat Cells for Electroporation
steps.instruction: Collect and wash 20 million Jurkat cells:

substeps.instruction: Spin cells at 350 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend in 25 mL PBS (first wash) and spin at 350 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend in 25 mL PBS (second wash) and spin at 350 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.
Resuspend the final pellet in 900 µL of R buffer.

steps.title: Electroporate Jurkat Cells
steps.instruction: Mix the Jurkat cell suspension in R buffer with the following mRNAs and electroporate:

substeps.instruction: Add 25 µL of mouse CD8A mRNA (~40 µg).
Add 25 µL of mouse CD8B mRNA (~40 µg).
Add 25 µL of mouse OT-I alpha mRNA (~40 µg).
Add 25 µL of mouse OT-I beta mRNA (~40 µg).
Mix well and electroporate.
Allow electroporated cells to recover for at least 12 hours.

steps.title: Seed Target MC38 Cells
steps.instruction: Seed MC38 cells into two solid-bottom white plates using 2-fold serial dilutions.

substeps.instruction: Prepare up to 6 replicates (row-wise) with 2-fold serial dilutions.
Use approximately 60 µL of media per well.
To achieve 100K cells in 60 µL, start the serial dilution at roughly 3.3 million cells/mL (requiring ~1.5 million cells per plate).
Allow target cells to attach and settle for at least 12 hours.

steps.title: Prepare and Pulse Jurkat Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare the electroporated Jurkat cells for co-culture:

substeps.instruction: Collect and combine all electroporated cells into a 50-mL falcon tube.
Spin at 350 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C and discard supernatant.
Resuspend in 10 mL fresh Jurkat media (~1.3 million cells/mL).
Split the suspension into two 15-mL falcon tubes (5 mL each).
Pulse one tube with 10 µM (9.63 ug/mL) SIINFEKL peptide.

steps.title: Set Up Co-culture
steps.instruction: Add electroporated Jurkats to the MC38 target cells.

substeps.instruction: Add 75 µL (~100K cells) of electroporated Jurkats to each well.
Label plates as 'pulsed' or 'unpulsed'.
Set up unpulsed conditions first to avoid cross-contamination.
Ensure target cells are titrated down from a 2:1 target:effector ratio using 2-fold serial dilution.

steps.title: Measure Luciferase Activity
steps.instruction: Quantify TCR reactivity using a luminescence plate reader (e.g., SpectraMax i3 Multi-Mode Microplate Detection Platform, Molecular Devices #i3x).

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate plates and luciferase substrates at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Add 75 µL of luciferase reagent to each well and incubate for 10 minutes.
Measure luminescence to determine reactivity relative to pulsed (positive) and unpulsed (negative) controls.
